## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) chat in the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) garret while [Diana](../character/diana.md) holds her small child. [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses finishing her teaching duties, her upcoming marriage to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and their plans to move to [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hears Anne's laughter from the kitchen below, reflecting warmly on Anne's future.
